title: Isolate packaged Python runtime from editable source links
summary: Prevent portable release runtimes from carrying editable MediaPipeline links back to the build checkout.
reason: A verified portable package contained editable-install metadata with an absolute local source path, which breaks package isolation and leaks workstation paths.
behavior_before: Release copies retain MediaPipeline editable .pth and direct_url metadata in both bundled Python runtimes.
behavior_after: Release copies exclude only MediaPipeline editable metadata while preserving legitimate third-party runtime .pth files.
tests_added: Release package policy assertions for both bundled Python runtimes.
manual_validation: GREEN: bundled PowerShell Invoke-ReleasePackagePolicyChecks.ps1 passed after narrow editable runtime exclusions and hygiene patterns.
GREEN: rerun the focused release package policy check after the narrow policy and hygiene updates.
RED: bundled PowerShell Invoke-ReleasePackagePolicyChecks.ps1 exited 1 because the editable MediaPipeline .pth had no exclusion rule.
RED: focused release package policy check fails until editable runtime metadata is excluded.
rollback_plan: Revert the narrow editable metadata exclusions if a supported package launcher is found to rely on them; launchers already set the package src path explicitly.
notes:
Add RED/GREEN coverage for bundled Python editable metadata exclusions.
Narrow release-copy and hygiene policy to remove editable MediaPipeline metadata only.
TDD RED reproduced before release policy implementation.
Focused policy test confirmed two editable artifacts excluded from each bundled Python runtime; fresh package verification remains pending.
